cases.requirement: Build a self-contained offline travel-expense entry prototype. It must accept a description and positive amount, reject a missing description and any non-positive amount, save a valid claim while showing the entered values, and let the user correct invalid input and save without reloading. Use only in-page mock storage; no backend or network is available.
constraints: Keep entered values after validation errors

cases.requirement: Build a self-contained workshop-enrollment prototype with name, email, and session selection. Require a name, reject a malformed email, show the selected session and name in the confirmation, and allow an invalid email to be corrected before enrollment completes. Use local mock behavior only; do not send email or use a backend.
constraints: Preserve form state after validation errors

cases.requirement: Build a self-contained maintenance-ticket prototype with category, location, and problem description. Require location and description, show the submitted category, location, and description, and allow a user to return from a validation error to successful submission. Submission is simulated in the page with no backend.

Build an offline directory for these four mock rooms: Orchid 101, capacity 8, North; Maple 204, capacity 16, North; Cedar 310, capacity 24, South; Willow 415, capacity 40, West. Show every record and provide capacity and building filters. Changing capacity must change matching records, combined filters must produce a meaningful empty state when nothing matches, and reset must restore all four records.
constraints: Use exactly the declared mock records

cases.requirement: Build an offline catalogue for these four mock lab supplies: Glass Beaker (Glassware), Nitrile Gloves (Safety), Digital Scale (Measurement), and Safety Goggles (Safety). Show every record and provide name search plus a category filter. Name search must narrow records, category and search must work together, and clearing a no-match search must restore matching records.
constraints: Use exactly the declared mock records

cases.requirement: Build an offline directory for these four mock courses: Data Ethics (Computing, Online), Web Systems (Computing, Campus), Modern Poetry (Humanities, Online), and Design History (Arts, Campus). Show every course and provide subject and delivery-mode filters. Subject filtering must work, delivery mode must further narrow results, and resetting an empty combination must restore all courses.
constraints: Use exactly the declared mock records

cases.requirement: Build an offline editorial-review prototype using the two declared articles, initially submitted. Show both article identities and statuses. Let a user start review of one article, approve it only after it is reviewing, and leave the other article unchanged. All workflow state is simulated in-page.
constraints: Use exactly the declared mock records
Enforce submitted to reviewing to approved order

cases.requirement: Build an offline parcel-handover prototype using the two declared parcels, initially waiting. Show both parcel identities and statuses. Let a user mark one parcel ready, collect it only through that ordered workflow, and leave the other parcel unchanged. All state is simulated in-page.
constraints: Use exactly the declared mock records
Enforce waiting to ready to collected order

cases.requirement: Build an offline volunteer-task prototype using the two declared tasks. Show both tasks, let a user assign a named volunteer to one task, complete the assigned task, and reopen it without changing the other task. All assignments and status changes are simulated in-page.
constraints: Use exactly the declared mock records

cases.requirement: Build an offline notice-composer prototype with title and body. The first save attempt must deliberately simulate a failure, show that failure, and preserve both entered values; retry must then show the saved title and body. No backend or network exists.
constraints: Exactly the first save attempt fails
Preserve title and body across failure

cases.requirement: Build an offline room-booking prototype with room and date. Require both fields. The first valid submit must deliberately simulate a failure while keeping the selected room and date; retry must show a matching booking confirmation. No backend or network exists.
constraints: Exactly the first valid submit fails
Preserve room and date across failure

cases.requirement: Build an offline bulk tag editor for the three declared sample records. Let the user select two while leaving one unselected. The first apply attempt must deliberately report failure and change no tags; retry must update only the selected records. All state is simulated in-page.
constraints: Exactly the first apply attempt fails
An unsuccessful apply changes no record tags
